14048.description:
The daily quests requires the following reagents:
Autumnal Herbs - 60 (12 stacks) 
Honey - 100 (20 stacks)
Wild Turkey - 20
Pumpkin - 20 (4 stacks)
Potato - 20 (4 stacks)
Cranberry - 20 (4 stacks)
Mild Spices - 20 (4 stacks)
Simple Flour - 20 (4 stacks)

The most effective route is to start at Stormwind/Undercity and farm the Wild Turkeys from Elwynn/Tirisfal, then get every reagent from vendor. Then move on to the two other cities for their dailies. Order does not matter, but remember to buy Cranberries and Potatoes from the respective vendors! Then return to Stormwind/Undercity for the rest.

24917.description:
Muradin: Oh lad, how I missed those endless days in Lordaeron, sharpening your skill with this dull blade. Forging you into a weapon meant to withstand the demands of a great destiny. Heh… You sure put them skills to use, didn't you lad?

If only I'd been able to stop you that day, how different things migha' been. If only I'da never discovered that accursed blade. Farewell, Arthas, my brother.

localFacts.description:

If only I'd been able to stop you that day, how different things migha' been. If only I'da never discovered that accursed blade. Farewell, Arthas, my brother.

24918.description:
Sylvanas: So, it is done. I had not dared to trust my senses. Too many times has the Lich King made me to be a fool. Finally, he has been made to pay for the atrocities he imposed upon my people.

May Azeroth never fail to remember the horrible price we paid for our weakness, for our pride. But what now, Hero? What of those freed from his grasp but still shackled to their mortal coils?

Leave me. I have much to ponder.

76249.description:
It's recommended to activate the Debug Mode to properly see every step and description.

To start unlocking old Scholomance, you must first do a clear of Heroic Scholomance. Once done, go to the room that used to be Doctor Theolen Krastinov's room in the original Scholomance (top center room). At the top left portion of the room, use the Krastinov's Bag of Horrors toy. When you do, the ghost of Eva Sarkhoff will spawn, afraid of you (as the toy transforms you into the Butcher himself). Removing the toy's buff will make Eva realize you're not her murderer, and she will talk to you, giving you the old Spectral Essence trinket and allowing you to loot Eva's Femur on the ground. This allows you to see ghosts in Caer Darrow.

Once you do, you can talk to Eva at her old spot outside Scholomance, where she will request you to look for her journal, as well as five candles, to perform a horrible ritual. The candles are traded from citizens in Caer Darrow, and require items they treasured when alive. Below, we have the locations for all items:

76257.description:
With 10.1.5, Blizzard readded the original version of Scholomance!

Thank you, Blizzard!
  -Crieve

Here is how to get started:

1. Obtain 'Krastinov's Bag of Horrors' from the rare spawn Doctor Theolen Krastinov in Scholomance, Heroic difficulty. This step can be skipped if you are accompanied by someone who already has the toy.

2. Defeat Darkmaster Gandling in Headmaster's Retreat and enter the upper level centre room.

3. Find a pile of bones on the ground in the southeastern part of the room, and use the toy 'Krastinov's Bag of Horrors'.

4. Eva Sarkhoff should now have spawned, but you cannot interact with her before you remove the toy visage/buff named 'Surgical Alterations'.

5. Accept Eva Sarkhoof's quest and her Inert Spectral Essence. Loot Eva's Femur from the pile of bones.

6. Walk back upstairs to The Viewing Room. There are two bookcases in the southwestern corner of the room. Eva's Journal can be found on a middle shelf on the backside of the left bookcase.

7. Obtain the reagents 3x Dark Runes and 5x Essence of Undeath and use the Inert Spectral Essence. Equip the crafted trinket 'Spectral Essence'.

8. Obtain candles from doing objectives around Caer Darrow (outside Scholomance):
8.1 Loot 'The Deed to Andorhal' from inside Andorhal Townhall at 43.35, 69.3, and give it to Magistrate Marduke at 70.5, 74.0.
8.2 Loot 'Bucket of Fountain Water' from the candlelit fountain at 68.9, 78.8, and give it to Joseph Dirte at 68.0, 74.8.
8.3 Loot 'Trampled Doll' from the meatwagon in Darrowshire at 35.7, 83.5. (Eastern Plaguelands!), return to Caer Darrow and give it to Sammy at 69.15, 78.7.
8.4 Loot 'The Road Ahead' from a wall inside old Corin's Crossing tavern  at 55.0, 64.0. (Eastern Plaguelands!), return to Caer Darrow and give it to Artist Renfray at 65.8, 75.4.
8.5 Loot 'Undelivered Shipment of Smokes' from a wagon behind the fountain at King's Square in Stratholme, return to Caer Darrow and give it to Rory at 63.4, 75.5.

9. Use Eva's Journal to begin the ritual at 69.7, 71.7, inside Caer Darrow keep/open world Scholomance.

76261.description:
When you have both the ward and holy water, head to the entrance of the Crusader's Cathedral, but don't enter there - Instead, use your Ward of Naxxramas and turn to the left. If done correctly, you will see a Dread Ward of Naxxramas right next to the gates there, Once you find the Dread Ward, toss your  Stratholme Holy Water in it.

If done correctly, you will receive a zone-wide yell, and a debuff called  Sleight of Hand. Once you get this debuff, you have 5 minutes to run all the way to the Undead side of Stratholme, to the gate to the left of the Necropolis where Lord Aurius Rivendare is located. You MUST kill Lord Aurius Rivendare to open the gate. If you arrive in time, a Hand of Naxxramas NPC will be there, and you will be able to use your Argent Dawn Commission to burn it to a crisp.

76263.description:
1. Make sure you have equipped your Argent Dawn Commission, and enter Stratholme through the Main Gate.

2. Kill mobs until Eye of Nazzramas spawns. Kill it and loot 'Ward of Naxxramas'.

3. Interact with a Supply Crate to obtain 'Stratholme Holy Water'.

4. Clear a path from Festival Lane through Market Row to Crusader's Square.

5. Use your 'Ward of Naxxramas' in Crusader's square to obtain truesight and you should find a Dread Ward by the southern gate. (Prematurely killing any bosses in Undead Stratholme will prevent this spawn!)

6. Use your 'Stratholme Holy Water' on the Dread Ward. This will trigger 'Sleight of Hand', and a five minute timer.

7. You now have 5 minutes to do the following:
7.1: Get back to Festival Lane and enter Elder's Square of the Undead seaction of Stratholme.
7.2: Kill all bosses in Undead Stratholme. Remember to also take out the cultists inside the ziggurats.
7.3: After killing Lord Aurius Rivendare in Slaughter Square, head into the southern gate where the Naxxramas portal is blocked off.
7.4: An undead creature named 'Hand of Naxxramas' should be waiting for you, and an Extra Action Button should appear. Use it to burn the creature to dust before the timer tuns out.

8. Travel to Light's Hope Chapel and find Archmage Angela Dosantos at 75.5, 52.8. Interact with her first, and she will offer a version of the quest named 'The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas' appropriate to your reputation with Argent Dawn. (Lower standing means she requires more gold and reagents from you, Exalted makes it free.)

9. You have now unlocked the ability to obtain Corruptor's Scourgestones on an accound-wide basis, as well as a portal to Naxxramas at coordinates 35.7, 23.1.

76307.description:
1. First you need to create a Makeshift Grappling Hook from the following items:

1.1 Abomination's Chain can be fished from any slime (green liquid), like the small pool just inside Arachnid Quarter.

1.2 Faerlina's Sewing Kit drops from Grand Widow Faerlina in the Arachnid Quarter.

1.3 Construct's Hook can be found on a handle under a vat of slime on the right side of the second room of the Construct Quarter.

2. Use your Makeshift Grappling Hook to get access to grapple points inside Naxxramas on an account-wide basis.

76390.description:
1. Kill all bosses in Construct Quarter, and walk back to the entrance of The Halls of Reanimation.

2. Walk up the slope to the platform on left side, and you should see two Grapple Point on two ledges to the left side. Grapple to the southern ledge.

3. Speed-jump (Burning Rush/Speed potion) to the platform northeast of the ledge, and position yourself such that you are facing the corresponding platform to the northern ledge. Said platform is connected to a wall structure with two windows on the top. The left window ledge is the location of the next grappling point. Grapple up to it.

4. Jump down to the brown ledge following the wall in a northeastern direction and around the corner, then over the skull on the wall, and back in a southeastern direction. The next grapple point is across the gap to a window ledge on left side, grapple to it.

5. Follow the ledge in a southwestern direction and around the corner. You should see two pipe ends on the wall in front of you, the next grappling point on the left pipe. Grapple to it.

6. Facing the position you grappled from, you should see Zackett Skullsmash on a window ledge. Jump down to the NPC.

7. Use Stratholme Holy Water on Zackett Skullsmash and accept the quest Inconvenience Fee. You should have all required items on you and be able to turn it in immediately. This unlocks Zackett Skullsmash on an account-wide basis, and the Goblin will move to the central ring.

8. You can safely get down by jumping down to the ledge above the entrance to the room, and leave through the Naxxramas Portal located where you killed Thaddius.

1. Fish out a 'Grisly Morsel' from 'Grisly Cod Pool'.

95956.description:
***Enable Debug Mode to see all the steps***
1. Talk to Forgotten Soldier and read the text on the Nameless Grave.
2. Find Zuzan sitting across The Ring of Glory Vendors
3. Find Zan'ja croaching atop one of the Defiant Ring pillars. Talk to him.
4. Find Ru'ko meditating atop one of the Arches of The Ring of Glory. Talk to her.
5. Go back to the Nameless Grave.

95995.description:

2. Go to the cave and present the Pearl to 'Nacretta'. It will give you the Key in exchange.
3. Loot the 'Dropped Key' and open the treasure.

96049.description: Val is a planet of nothing but ice-covered valleys and billowing storms; even the Legion loathed it. The planet is protected by enormous hailstorms capable of tearing through the hulls of Legion ships, and even after the demons established outposts, the soldiers sent there were usually done so as punishment.

96052.description: Naigtal, is a world of giant mushrooms, rich in arcane energy, covered in vast oceans with ley lines running beneath them. The Azerothian forces on Naigtal during the War of Light and Shadow presume the natives to have been wiped out by the Legion.

98551.description:
Repeatable special Prey Mob on The Coiled Isle.
Spawned as a public event by burning 98x Ossified Relic at a Haunted Brazier. Has Delayed Demise (immune 15s on spawn), keep attacking or he despawns and the Relics are lost.

Requires Preyhunter's Journey Rank 1 unlocked and Prey: Curse of the Isle, activated by Astalor Bloodsworn, npc 266481.
To see/fight him and to get loot you must personally burn at least 1x Ossified Relic at the brazier.

14048.description:
The daily quests requires the following reagents:
Autumnal Herbs - 60 (12 stacks) 
Honey - 100 (20 stacks)
Wild Turkey - 20
Pumpkin - 20 (4 stacks)
Potato - 20 (4 stacks)
Cranberry - 20 (4 stacks)
Mild Spices - 20 (4 stacks)
Simple Flour - 20 (4 stacks)

The most effective route is to start at Stormwind/Undercity and farm the Wild Turkeys from Elwynn/Tirisfal, then get every reagent from vendor. Then move on to the two other cities for their dailies. Order does not matter, but remember to buy Cranberries and Potatoes from the respective vendors! Then return to Stormwind/Undercity for the rest.

24917.description:
Muradin: Oh lad, how I missed those endless days in Lordaeron, sharpening your skill with this dull blade. Forging you into a weapon meant to withstand the demands of a great destiny. Heh… You sure put them skills to use, didn't you lad?

If only I'd been able to stop you that day, how different things migha' been. If only I'da never discovered that accursed blade. Farewell, Arthas, my brother.

24918.description:
Sylvanas: So, it is done. I had not dared to trust my senses. Too many times has the Lich King made me to be a fool. Finally, he has been made to pay for the atrocities he imposed upon my people.

May Azeroth never fail to remember the horrible price we paid for our weakness, for our pride. But what now, Hero? What of those freed from his grasp but still shackled to their mortal coils?

Leave me. I have much to ponder.

76249.description:
It's recommended to activate the Debug Mode to properly see every step and description.

To start unlocking old Scholomance, you must first do a clear of Heroic Scholomance. Once done, go to the room that used to be Doctor Theolen Krastinov's room in the original Scholomance (top center room). At the top left portion of the room, use the Krastinov's Bag of Horrors toy. When you do, the ghost of Eva Sarkhoff will spawn, afraid of you (as the toy transforms you into the Butcher himself). Removing the toy's buff will make Eva realize you're not her murderer, and she will talk to you, giving you the old Spectral Essence trinket and allowing you to loot Eva's Femur on the ground. This allows you to see ghosts in Caer Darrow.

Once you do, you can talk to Eva at her old spot outside Scholomance, where she will request you to look for her journal, as well as five candles, to perform a horrible ritual. The candles are traded from citizens in Caer Darrow, and require items they treasured when alive. Below, we have the locations for all items:

76257.description:
With 10.1.5, Blizzard readded the original version of Scholomance!

Thank you, Blizzard!
  -Crieve

Here is how to get started:

1. Obtain 'Krastinov's Bag of Horrors' from the rare spawn Doctor Theolen Krastinov in Scholomance, Heroic difficulty. This step can be skipped if you are accompanied by someone who already has the toy.

2. Defeat Darkmaster Gandling in Headmaster's Retreat and enter the upper level centre room.

3. Find a pile of bones on the ground in the southeastern part of the room, and use the toy 'Krastinov's Bag of Horrors'.

4. Eva Sarkhoff should now have spawned, but you cannot interact with her before you remove the toy visage/buff named 'Surgical Alterations'.

5. Accept Eva Sarkhoof's quest and her Inert Spectral Essence. Loot Eva's Femur from the pile of bones.

6. Walk back upstairs to The Viewing Room. There are two bookcases in the southwestern corner of the room. Eva's Journal can be found on a middle shelf on the backside of the left bookcase.

7. Obtain the reagents 3x Dark Runes and 5x Essence of Undeath and use the Inert Spectral Essence. Equip the crafted trinket 'Spectral Essence'.

8. Obtain candles from doing objectives around Caer Darrow (outside Scholomance):
8.1 Loot 'The Deed to Andorhal' from inside Andorhal Townhall at 43.35, 69.3, and give it to Magistrate Marduke at 70.5, 74.0.
8.2 Loot 'Bucket of Fountain Water' from the candlelit fountain at 68.9, 78.8, and give it to Joseph Dirte at 68.0, 74.8.
8.3 Loot 'Trampled Doll' from the meatwagon in Darrowshire at 35.7, 83.5. (Eastern Plaguelands!), return to Caer Darrow and give it to Sammy at 69.15, 78.7.
8.4 Loot 'The Road Ahead' from a wall inside old Corin's Crossing tavern  at 55.0, 64.0. (Eastern Plaguelands!), return to Caer Darrow and give it to Artist Renfray at 65.8, 75.4.
8.5 Loot 'Undelivered Shipment of Smokes' from a wagon behind the fountain at King's Square in Stratholme, return to Caer Darrow and give it to Rory at 63.4, 75.5.

9. Use Eva's Journal to begin the ritual at 69.7, 71.7, inside Caer Darrow keep/open world Scholomance.

76261.description:
When you have both the ward and holy water, head to the entrance of the Crusader's Cathedral, but don't enter there - Instead, use your Ward of Naxxramas and turn to the left. If done correctly, you will see a Dread Ward of Naxxramas right next to the gates there, Once you find the Dread Ward, toss your  Stratholme Holy Water in it.

If done correctly, you will receive a zone-wide yell, and a debuff called  Sleight of Hand. Once you get this debuff, you have 5 minutes to run all the way to the Undead side of Stratholme, to the gate to the left of the Necropolis where Lord Aurius Rivendare is located. You MUST kill Lord Aurius Rivendare to open the gate. If you arrive in time, a Hand of Naxxramas NPC will be there, and you will be able to use your Argent Dawn Commission to burn it to a crisp.

76263.description:
1. Make sure you have equipped your Argent Dawn Commission, and enter Stratholme through the Main Gate.

2. Kill mobs until Eye of Nazzramas spawns. Kill it and loot 'Ward of Naxxramas'.

3. Interact with a Supply Crate to obtain 'Stratholme Holy Water'.

4. Clear a path from Festival Lane through Market Row to Crusader's Square.

5. Use your 'Ward of Naxxramas' in Crusader's square to obtain truesight and you should find a Dread Ward by the southern gate. (Prematurely killing any bosses in Undead Stratholme will prevent this spawn!)

6. Use your 'Stratholme Holy Water' on the Dread Ward. This will trigger 'Sleight of Hand', and a five minute timer.

7. You now have 5 minutes to do the following:
7.1: Get back to Festival Lane and enter Elder's Square of the Undead seaction of Stratholme.
7.2: Kill all bosses in Undead Stratholme. Remember to also take out the cultists inside the ziggurats.
7.3: After killing Lord Aurius Rivendare in Slaughter Square, head into the southern gate where the Naxxramas portal is blocked off.
7.4: An undead creature named 'Hand of Naxxramas' should be waiting for you, and an Extra Action Button should appear. Use it to burn the creature to dust before the timer tuns out.

8. Travel to Light's Hope Chapel and find Archmage Angela Dosantos at 75.5, 52.8. Interact with her first, and she will offer a version of the quest named 'The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas' appropriate to your reputation with Argent Dawn. (Lower standing means she requires more gold and reagents from you, Exalted makes it free.)

9. You have now unlocked the ability to obtain Corruptor's Scourgestones on an accound-wide basis, as well as a portal to Naxxramas at coordinates 35.7, 23.1.

76307.description:
1. First you need to create a Makeshift Grappling Hook from the following items:

1.1 Abomination's Chain can be fished from any slime (green liquid), like the small pool just inside Arachnid Quarter.

1.2 Faerlina's Sewing Kit drops from Grand Widow Faerlina in the Arachnid Quarter.

1.3 Construct's Hook can be found on a handle under a vat of slime on the right side of the second room of the Construct Quarter.

2. Use your Makeshift Grappling Hook to get access to grapple points inside Naxxramas on an account-wide basis.

76390.description:
1. Kill all bosses in Construct Quarter, and walk back to the entrance of The Halls of Reanimation.

2. Walk up the slope to the platform on left side, and you should see two Grapple Point on two ledges to the left side. Grapple to the southern ledge.

3. Speed-jump (Burning Rush/Speed potion) to the platform northeast of the ledge, and position yourself such that you are facing the corresponding platform to the northern ledge. Said platform is connected to a wall structure with two windows on the top. The left window ledge is the location of the next grappling point. Grapple up to it.

4. Jump down to the brown ledge following the wall in a northeastern direction and around the corner, then over the skull on the wall, and back in a southeastern direction. The next grapple point is across the gap to a window ledge on left side, grapple to it.

5. Follow the ledge in a southwestern direction and around the corner. You should see two pipe ends on the wall in front of you, the next grappling point on the left pipe. Grapple to it.

6. Facing the position you grappled from, you should see Zackett Skullsmash on a window ledge. Jump down to the NPC.

7. Use Stratholme Holy Water on Zackett Skullsmash and accept the quest Inconvenience Fee. You should have all required items on you and be able to turn it in immediately. This unlocks Zackett Skullsmash on an account-wide basis, and the Goblin will move to the central ring.

8. You can safely get down by jumping down to the ledge above the entrance to the room, and leave through the Naxxramas Portal located where you killed Thaddius.

routes.description:
1. Kill all bosses in Construct Quarter, and walk back to the entrance of The Halls of Reanimation.

2. Walk up the slope to the platform on left side, and you should see two Grapple Point on two ledges to the left side. Grapple to the southern ledge.

3. Speed-jump (Burning Rush/Speed potion) to the platform northeast of the ledge, and position yourself such that you are facing the corresponding platform to the northern ledge. Said platform is connected to a wall structure with two windows on the top. The left window ledge is the location of the next grappling point. Grapple up to it.

4. Jump down to the brown ledge following the wall in a northeastern direction and around the corner, then over the skull on the wall, and back in a southeastern direction. The next grapple point is across the gap to a window ledge on left side, grapple to it.

5. Follow the ledge in a southwestern direction and around the corner. You should see two pipe ends on the wall in front of you, the next grappling point on the left pipe. Grapple to it.

6. Facing the position you grappled from, you should see Zackett Skullsmash on a window ledge. Jump down to the NPC.

7. Use Stratholme Holy Water on Zackett Skullsmash and accept the quest Inconvenience Fee. You should have all required items on you and be able to turn it in immediately. This unlocks Zackett Skullsmash on an account-wide basis, and the Goblin will move to the central ring.

8. You can safely get down by jumping down to the ledge above the entrance to the room, and leave through the Naxxramas Portal located where you killed Thaddius.

routes.description: You need to kill |cFFFFD700Glittering Grouper Brinetail|r and obtain 3 |cFFFFFFFFDiver's Key Fragments|r. Combining them gives you a |cFFFFFFFFDiver's Key|r.

***Enable Debug Mode to see all the steps***
1. Talk to Forgotten Soldier and read the text on the Nameless Grave.
2. Find Zuzan sitting across The Ring of Glory Vendors
3. Find Zan'ja croaching atop one of the Defiant Ring pillars. Talk to him.
4. Find Ru'ko meditating atop one of the Arches of The Ring of Glory. Talk to her.
5. Go back to the Nameless Grave.

1. Find a 'Bubbling Clam' under water to the south of the Cave and obtain a 'Luminescent Pearl'.
2. Go to the cave and present the Pearl to 'Nacretta'. It will give you the Key in exchange.
3. Loot the 'Dropped Key' and open the treasure.

1. Fish out a 'Grisly Morsel' from 'Grisly Cod Pool'.
2. Feed the 'Hungry Dolphin' to gain it as your companion.
3. Dive down and swim around the bay area until the Dolphin helps you find both pieces of the key. DO NOT RESURFACE!
4. Combine both halves of the key.
5. Loot the treasure.
Becomes available after unlocking Labyrinth Renown LVL3: Akil'zon's Favor.

routes.description:
The process to summon this boss is as follows.

1. Collect Shadow Dust from mobs in Skettis.
2. Turn in 6 Shadow Dust to Severin for the quest More Shadow Dust to obtain Elixir of Shadows.
3. Drink the elixir to gain a 20-minute buff that allows you to see Time-Lost mobs around Skettis.
4. Kill these mobs to obtain Time-Lost Scrolls (40 required per summon).
5. Make sure you are on the Adversarial Blood quest if this is your first time; it begins with the quest Ishaal's Almanac.
6. Go to a skull pile and use 10 Time-Lost Scrolls to summon boss. (Darkscreecher Akkarai [Akkarai's Talons], Karrog [Karrog's Spine], Gezzarak the Huntress [Gezzarak's Claws], Vakkiz the Windrager [Vakkiz's Scale]).
7. Take these 4 items to Hazzik to complete Adversarial Blood which rewards a Time-Lost Offering.
8. Use the Time-Lost Offering at the Ancient Skull Pile on middle island to summon Terokk. (It has about a 15-minute spawn timer)

routes.description:
Muradin: Oh lad, how I missed those endless days in Lordaeron, sharpening your skill with this dull blade. Forging you into a weapon meant to withstand the demands of a great destiny. Heh… You sure put them skills to use, didn't you lad?

If only I'd been able to stop you that day, how different things migha' been. If only I'da never discovered that accursed blade. Farewell, Arthas, my brother.

lineage.description:
Dropped by the Lich King on 25-Man difficulty while on the quest |cFFefc400The Lich King's Last Stand|r. Only your first kill will trigger the item to drop. You do NOT need to have Shadowmourne equipped.

This item contains a lot of BoE cosmetic items that sell very well. During its time, this was used to reward other members of the raid for assisting the guild master (more than likely) with Shadowmourne for the many months it took to complete the quest chain.

In addition to being very rewarding, these quests were some of the most treasured throughout World of Warcraft's long history.

routes.description:
Sylvanas: So, it is done. I had not dared to trust my senses. Too many times has the Lich King made me to be a fool. Finally, he has been made to pay for the atrocities he imposed upon my people.

May Azeroth never fail to remember the horrible price we paid for our weakness, for our pride. But what now, Hero? What of those freed from his grasp but still shackled to their mortal coils?

Leave me. I have much to ponder.

routes.description:
Tol Barad Peninsula is the northernmost region of the island of Tol Barad and is a major daily quest hub in World of Warcraft: Cataclysm.

Due to how sharding works, you will usually only get the same eight daily quests from the camp in Tol Barad Peninsula. The trick for having a chance at getting offered some of the other quests in rotation is to have zoned into Tol Barad Peninsula a few minutes before the daily reset occurs. Then you can wait for the daily reset, or leave the zone for up to 15 minutes before returning. Protip: Do the same with Warmode on, which zones you to a different shard. Quests picked up in Warmode can be completed and turned in outside Warmode.

This Fisherfriend NPC is located at: |cFFFFFFFF43.2, 40.6|r north of Illidari Stand.

The Fisherfriend NPCs will not always be up and only one is up at any given time. You will have to either travel to the zone, ask a friend or check group finder to see if they are up.

When fishing for the item for this particular fisherfriend make sure that you are close enough so that you receive the buff |cFFFFD700Something's Fishy|r, otherwise you won't be able to receive the turn-in items or the boss that is summoned.

It is recommended to be in a group in order to be able to reach Best Friend the quickest.

routes.description:
This Toy, Pocket Fel Spreader is available EXCLUSIVELY during the Legion pre-expansion event. It is obtained by using any ability or item that allows you to detect demons, and then speaking to a Doomsayer. 
When using any such ability or item, the Doomsayer will sometimes have the dialogue option "There's something not quite right about you...". Selecting this option, when visible, will change the Doomsayer into a Dread Infiltrator, which can be killed and looted to obtain this Toy. Note that the Toy is NOT a guaranteed drop, but has a roughly 25% drop rate.

routes.description:
To get this item you have to jump through the following hoops:

|cFFFFFFFFStep 1:|r Purchase a |CFFFFD700Sack of "Discarded" Hearthstones|r from |CFFCC33FFGriftah|r |cFFFFFFFF[Coords: 53.02, 89.93]|r.
|cFFFFFFFFStep 2:|r Now visit |CFFCC33FFRakle the Wretched|r and trade him the |CFFFFD700Sack of "Discarded" Hearthstones|r to receive a |CFFFFD700Much-Too-Hot-Pepper|r |cFFFFFFFF[Coords: 34.77, 11.58]|r.
|cFFFFFFFFStep 3:|r Visit |CFFCC33FFTrader Haw'li|r and trade them the |CFFFFD700Much-Too-Hot-Pepper|r for some |CFFFFD700Golden Seeds|r |cFFFFFFFF[Coords: 37.81, 14.72]|r.
|cFFFFFFFFStep 4:|r Visit |CFFCC33FFGranda Watae|r and trade them the |CFFFFD700Golden Seeds|r for a |CFFFFD700Centennial Blossom|r |cFFFFFFFF[Coords: 42.16, 35.78]|r.
|cFFFFFFFFStep 5:|r Visit |CFFCC33FFTrader Nog|r and trade them the |CFFFFD700Centennial Blossom|r for a |CFFFFD700Preserved Night Elf Head|r |cFFFFFFFF[Coords: 57.15, 91.47]|r.
|cFFFFFFFFStep 6:|r Visit |CFFCC33FF"Black Eye" Zenru|r and trade them the |CFFFFD700Preserved Night Elf Head|r for a |CFFFFD700Counterfeit Rastakhan Mask|r |cFFFFFFFF[Coords: 53.77, 85.97]|r.
|cFFFFFFFFStep 7:|r Return back to |CFFCC33FFGriftah|r and you will trade him the |CFFFFD700Counterfeit Rastakhan Mask|r in exchange for the toy |cFFFFFFFF[Coords: 53.02, 89.93]|r.

routes.description: These rewards were made available to anyone who purchased Dragonflight Epic Edition.
You should receive a letter from Ve'nari with the toy attached 5 days after interacting with her decoy corpse in Zereth Mortis.

Break the Meta: SL Season 4

Instead of teams fighting to beat their opponent's time, Break the Meta is focused on teams pushing keys as high as they can with Season's 4 off-meta specs and classes.

Register for the event on |cFFFFFFFFRaider.io/break-the-meta-2022|r and complete 2 or more eligible timed keystones at level 15 or higher during BTM S4, and the Shrouded Banner of the Opportune will be automatically added to your collection in-game within 30 days of the conclusion of the event.

The Event starts on October 4th for US, October 5th for EU & October 6th for KR/TW & lasts for the entire reset of your region.

This was previously available through The Great Push: SL Season 4.

routes.description:
In order to summon Omen you need to fire 30 cluster rockets from the launcer at 63.73, 62.41. Any will do. The spawns Minion of Omen can be ignored.

Elune's Blessing is obtained from a ring of light appearing on Omen's corpse. The light does not disappear when the corpse despawns, so you might not need to fight Omen at all.
